info.name: Airmeet Public Authentication Event Details API

description.content:
The Airmeet Public API lets you programmatically manage events (Airmeets), registrations, sessions, speakers, booths and event series on the Airmeet virtual, hybrid and in-person events platform, and read back event engagement and attendance data. Authentication is a two-step flow: exchange an access key and secret key at POST /auth for a bearer access token (valid 30 days), then send that token as the X-Airmeet-Access-Token header on every other request. Several read endpoints (attendees, booth attendance, UTMs, replay attendance) are asynchronous and return a job/URL to poll for the result. Responses share a { "success": boolean, "data": ... } envelope.
